newsitem.title: USA: Yellow Q1 net rises on higher prices.
newsitem.headline: Yellow Q1 net rises on higher prices.

text.p: Yellow Corp said an increase in shipping rates and improved efficiencies in the wake of a restucturing last year helped earnings improve in the first quarter ended March 31.
The less-than-truckload shipping firm posted net income of $6.5 million, or $0.23 a share, versus a loss ot $14.3 million, or $0.51, in the same period last year
Revenues rose to $785.1 million from $741.7 million in the first quarter of 1996.

Yellow said its improved performance was primarily because of a 4.6 percent increase in tonnage shipped per day, a 2.7 percent average increase in freight rates and aggressive cost controls. The company said it trimmed costs by $75 million in 1996 and expects to realize savings of $142 million in 1997.
